inputs.question: Confirm MacroKinetic as the public name and rights to the name, icon, and store artwork.
Confirm the legal seller and Developer Program entity eligibility for this health-data scope.
Provide the supported public contact and legal contact details appropriate for launch regions.
Confirm the owned domain, publication authority, and tested support, privacy, and terms URLs.
Resolve KAT-3584. Confirm health-data storage, sync, backup, retention, deletion, and processor facts.
Approve privacy answers using the final data-flow inventory and actual processor access.
Confirm launch regions, age questionnaire answers, minimum age, and substantiated medical-device declaration.
Confirm launch pricing, subscriptions off, and relevant agreements, tax, banking, and regional trader requirements.
Confirm App Review contact, review access, account-flow instructions, and any Apple-approved demo mode.
Confirm export-compliance answers and evidence of a submission-eligible signed candidate under KAT-3594.
